limits: These controls were motivated by DS13, DS14 and DS31. All datasets have already been examined. The same public archive supplies measured geometry, diffraction and camera calibration. Compare each diagnostic directly with the fixed baseline and interpret other maps as sensitivity to those choices.
scope: Retrospective fixed diagnostics across the local geometry folds. For MoS2 bilayers retain measured geometry in the diffraction calculation and remove mean dilation from the mechanics only. For mixed materials carry the DS31 raw-lattice longitudinal multiplier unchanged to all mixed-material maps.
